name: Visiting / Tourism Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Travel purpose limited to tourism, sightseeing, or visiting family/friends -- no employment permitted.
Return/onward ticket and bank statement proving sufficient funds required.

outcome.duration_length: 30 days (single entry); up to 180 days per visit / 5 years validity (multiple entry, reciprocity-based); tourism visa capped at 30 days single-entry

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS) -- Nigerian Visa categories: Visiting Visa (Single Entry, 30 days) and Visiting Visa (Multiple Entry, up to 5 years validity / 180 days per visit, granted based on reciprocity), plus Tourism Visa (30 days, single-entry); no employment permitted, non-extendable

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Nigeria). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 NIS sourced. This dataset merges NIS's separate 'Visiting Visa' (social/family visits) and 'Tourism Visa' (sightseeing) categories into one visit-category file since both share the same 30-day single-entry default and no-employment restriction; the multiple-entry variant (up to 5 years validity, 180 days/visit) is captured in duration_length rather than modeled as a separate file. NIS also lists numerous specialized short-stay visas not modeled separately here (sports, creative arts, study tour, journalist, cleric, medical/religious tourism, humanitarian services, INGO/NGO staff, emergency relief) -- all share the same core 'no employment, largely non-extendable, purpose-specific documentation' structure and are disclosed here rather than fragmented into a dozen near-identical route files. E-visas available for most short-stay categories; embassy processing required for stays exceeding 90 days.
